schedule_metadata.title: Himachal Pradesh Public Works Department (HPPWD) & MoRTH Schedule of Rates for Hill Roads
primary_references: HPPWD Schedule of Rates (HPSOR), Government of Himachal Pradesh
Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) Specifications for Road and Bridge Works (5th Revision)
Standard Data Book for Analysis of Rates for Road and Bridge Works, IRC / MoRTH
schedule_metadata.applicable_terrain: Himalayan Hill Roads & High Altitude Sectors

earthwork_and_clearance.description: Hydraulic excavation of saturated landslide debris, loose soil, and boulders up to 3 m³ using heavy hydraulic breaker excavator, including loading into tippers and disposal with lead up to 1000m.
Slope trimming, scarp reprofiling, and dressing of unstable overburden cut face to stable bench profile in all kinds of soil and soft rock.
Foundation trench excavation in hard rock / compact boulder strata with pneumatic breaker tools, including necessary shoring, strutting, and dewatering.

structural_retention.description: Construction of Plum Concrete Retaining / Breast Wall in M15 grade concrete (1:2:4) with 30% to 40% clean sound quarry plum boulders (density >= 18 kN/m³), including steel shuttering, scaffolding, compaction, and 14 days water curing.
Supplying and laying non-woven needle-punched polypropylene geotextile filter fabric (weight >= 250 GSM, O90 < 0.15 mm) behind retaining wall backface.
Providing and laying free-draining granular backfill filter material (crushed stone gravel 20-40mm) behind retaining wall in layers not exceeding 150mm compacted thickness.
Providing and installing 100mm dia heavy-duty PVC weep hole pipes (Class 3) placed at 1.20m c/c staggered with 1:20 outward slope and gravel filter envelope at inlet.

internal_ground_reinforcement.description: Rotary / percussive drilling of 100mm to 110mm dia boreholes in soil/colluvium/fractured rock for soil nails at 15° to 20° downward rake to specified design length.
Supplying, cutting, threading, and inserting Dia. 25mm to 32mm Fe500 high-yield deformed steel soil nail bars with polypropylene centralizers @ 2m c/c.
Pressure grouting of soil nail boreholes with non-shrink neat cementitious grout (f_cu >= 30 MPa @ 28 days, W/C = 0.42, injection pressure 0.3-0.5 MPa).
Cast-in-situ reinforced concrete bearing pad (400x400x200mm Grade C30/37) with galvanized steel bearing plate (200x200x20mm) and high-tensile spherical hex nut assembly.
Sacrificial pullout verification proof testing of soil nails using hydraulic hollow-plunger jack up to 1.5x design working load with dial gauge creep recording.

drainage_works.description: Directional drilling and installation of 50mm to 75mm dia heavy-duty slotted PVC sub-horizontal relief drains (Schedule 80) jacketed with non-woven geotextile filter sock at 5° to 10° upward rake.
Construction of Stone Masonry Hillside Saucer Catch Drain (0.60m wide x 0.60m deep) in cement mortar 1:4 with 100mm M15 concrete bedding and pointing.
Construction of stepped cascade drainage chute lined with stone pitching and concrete cross-weirs discharging into natural ravine.

barrier_and_bioengineering.description: Supply and erection of 500 kJ certified flexible wire-rope ring net rockfall barrier (Height 3.0m to 4.0m, HEB 140 structural steel posts, stainless steel friction brake rings, wire-rope anchor cables).
Supply and erection of 1500 kJ to 3000 kJ certified heavy-duty flexible ring net barrier (Height 4.0m to 5.0m, HEB 180 posts, ROCCO ring nets, high-energy dissipators).

Soil bioengineering: Supplying and laying open-weave coir geotextile netting (700 GSM) anchored with bamboo pins, hydroseeding with native grass mixes, and planting deep-rooting Vetiver grass (Chrysopogon zizanioides) contour hedges.
